Frequently Asked Questions

When exactly are you launching?
January 2026. We'll notify all registered restaurants 1 week before launch.
Do I pay anything now?
No. Registration is free. Growth Plan (99 AED/month for Founding Partners) is optional.
What if no customers order?
You lose nothing. We're taking all the risk. We're confident because our AI system is tested and we're focused on UAE only.

We're limiting to 50 Founding Partners in UAE. Currently 38 registered (12 spots left).
Why join NOW?
Money. Founding Partners save ~600 AED/year with 50% lifetime discount + 500+ AED in featured placement. After launch, everyone pays full price.
Is 50% discount really forever?
Yes. Locked permanently. Even if we raise prices, Founding Partners keep 99 AED rate for life.
